parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const fail=(statusCode,error)=>[{json:{ok:false,statusCode,error}}];const authorization=$json.headers?.authorization??'';if(!authorization.startsWith('Bearer '))return fail(401,'Sesión requerida.');try{const secret=$env.JWT_SECRET,[h,p,s,x]=authorization.slice(7).trim().split('.');if(!secret||!h||!p||!s||x)throw new Error();const expected=crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(`${h}.${p}`).digest('base64url');if(s.length!==expected.length||!crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(s),Buffer.from(expected)))throw new Error();const payload=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(p,'base64url').toString('utf8'));if(!payload.exp||payload.exp<=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000))throw new Error();const role=String(payload.rol??payload.role??'').toUpperCase(),permissions=(Array.isArray(payload.permisos)?payload.permisos:[]).map(String);if(role!=='ADMINISTRADOR_PARKING'&&!permissions.includes('parqueadero.gestionar'))return fail(403,'No tiene permisos.');const id=Number($json.body?.id),reason=String($json.body?.reason??'').trim();if(!Number.isInteger(id)||id<=0||!reason||reason.length>300)return fail(400,'Indique la solicitud y un motivo de rechazo válido.');return[{json:{ok:true,id,reason}}];}catch{return fail(401,'La sesión es inválida o ha vencido.');}

parameters.query: UPDATE public.parqueadero_pagos SET estado='RECHAZADO',motivo_rechazo=$2 WHERE id=$1::bigint AND estado='PENDIENTE' RETURNING TRUE success,id::int id,NULL::int AS "authorizationId";

parameters.responseBody: ={{$json.success ? $json : {error:'La solicitud no existe o ya fue procesada.'}}}
